1: """Generated-only inherited ReadSet adoption; no I/O or native import at import.
2: 
3: The fixed trusted bootstrap supplies both primitives and the authenticated
4: channel. Public records and wire integers are not independent authority.
5: """
6: import hashlib
7: import json
8: from types import MappingProxyType
9: from pinned_buffer_namespace import BufferAsset, PinnedBufferNamespace
10: from win32_worker_connection import FileIdentity, ReadSet, _absolute_local_path
11: 
12: NAMES = ("config.json", "model.bin", "preprocessor_config.json", "tokenizer.json", "vocabulary.json")
13: GENERATED = MappingProxyType({name: ("Uoink generated adoption fixture: " + name + ". No model data.\n").encode("ascii")
14:                               for name in NAMES})
15: PAYLOAD_BYTES = sum(len(value) for value in GENERATED.values())
16: FORMAT = "uoink.generated-inherited-readset.v1"
17: CASES = frozenset(("positive", "wrong_identity"))
18: 
19: 
20: class AdoptionRefusal(RuntimeError):
21:     pass
22: 
23: 
24: def _require(condition, reason):
25:     if not condition:
26:         raise AdoptionRefusal(reason)
27: 
28: 
29: def _canonical(value):
30:     return json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=True,
31:                       allow_nan=False).encode("ascii")
32: 
33: 
34: def namespace_digest():
35:     rows = [[name, len(GENERATED[name]), hashlib.sha256(GENERATED[name]).hexdigest()] for name in NAMES]
36:     return hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(rows, separators=(",", ":")).encode("ascii")).hexdigest()
37: 
38: 
39: def manifest_digest(payload):
40:     return hashlib.sha256(_canonical(payload)).hexdigest()
41: 
42: 
43: def fixed_paths(root):
44:     _absolute_local_path(root)  # Lexical only; no resolve/stat/open.
45:     _require(not root.endswith("\\"), "fixed_generated_directory_required")
46:     return tuple(_absolute_local_path(root + "\\" + name) for name in NAMES)
47: 
48: 
49: def _identity_row(identity):
50:     _require(type(identity) is FileIdentity, "exact_file_identity_type")
51:     return {"final_path": identity.final_path, "volume_serial": identity.volume_serial,
52:             "file_id": identity.file_id.hex(), "size": identity.size,
53:             "links": identity.links, "directory": identity.directory}
54: 
55: 
56: def controller_manifest(primitives, read_set, worker, root, case):
57:     """Called serially before child resume by the actual lifecycle start port."""
58:     paths = fixed_paths(root)
59:     _require(case in CASES and type(case) is str, "fixed_generated_case")
60:     _require(any(item is read_set for item in primitives.read_sets)
61:              and any(item is worker for item in primitives.workers)
62:              and worker.read_set is read_set and worker.assigned and not worker.resumed
63:              and not worker.unconfirmed and not read_set.unconfirmed and not read_set.released,
64:              "exact_suspended_owned_worker_required")
65:     _require(len(read_set.members) == len(read_set.identities) == len(worker.child_read_handles) == 5
66:              and all(handle.closed for handle in worker.inherited_copies), "exact_inheritance_membership")
67:     rows = []
68:     for index, name in enumerate(NAMES):
69:         handle, expected = read_set.members[index], read_set.identities[index]
70:         primitives._owned(handle)
71:         _require(primitives.identity(handle) == expected, "parent_guard_identity_changed")
72:         row = {"name": name, "handle": worker.child_read_handles[index],
73:                "identity": _identity_row(expected), "sha256": hashlib.sha256(GENERATED[name]).hexdigest()}
74:         rows.append(row)
75:     if case == "wrong_identity":
76:         # The complete authenticated negative manifest deliberately binds the
77:         # wrong first file ID. No message tampering or invalid MAC is simulated.
78:         altered = bytearray.fromhex(rows[0]["identity"]["file_id"])
79:         altered[0] ^= 1
80:         rows[0]["identity"]["file_id"] = bytes(altered).hex()
81:     payload = {"schema": FORMAT, "case": case, "namespace_sha256": namespace_digest(), "members": rows}
82:     validate_manifest(payload, root, case, worker.child_control_handle, manifest_digest(payload))
83:     return payload
84: 
85: 
86: def validate_manifest(payload, root, case, control_value, expected_manifest_sha256):
87:     """Validate the entire authenticated passive message before handle calls."""
88:     paths = fixed_paths(root)
89:     _require(type(payload) is dict and set(payload) == {"schema", "case", "namespace_sha256", "members"},
90:              "adoption_manifest_shape")
91:     _require(type(case) is str and case in CASES and payload["schema"] == FORMAT
92:              and payload["case"] == case and payload["namespace_sha256"] == namespace_digest(),
93:              "fixed_adoption_scope")
94:     rows = payload["members"]
95:     _require(type(rows) is list and len(rows) == 5, "five_ordered_generated_members")
96:     _require(type(control_value) is int and 0 < control_value < (1 << 64) - 1, "fixed_control_handle")
97:     values, validated = set(), []
98:     for index, row in enumerate(rows):
99:         _require(type(row) is dict and set(row) == {"name", "handle", "identity", "sha256"}, "member_shape")
100:         name, value, identity = row["name"], row["handle"], row["identity"]
101:         _require(type(name) is str and name == NAMES[index], "member_order_and_name")
102:         _require(type(value) is int and 0 < value < (1 << 64) - 1 and value != control_value
103:                  and value not in values, "unique_inherited_file_handle")
104:         values.add(value)
105:         _require(type(row["sha256"]) is str and row["sha256"] == hashlib.sha256(GENERATED[name]).hexdigest(),
106:                  "generated_member_digest")
107:         _require(type(identity) is dict and set(identity) == {"final_path", "volume_serial", "file_id", "size", "links", "directory"},
108:                  "complete_file_identity")
109:         final_path = identity["final_path"]
110:         # GetFinalPathNameByHandleW(flags=0) returns this fixed extended DOS
111:         # spelling. Compare lexically; never follow a path supplied by a frame.
112:         _require(type(final_path) is str and len(final_path) <= 4096
113:                  and final_path.casefold() == ("\\\\?\\" + paths[index]).casefold(), "fixed_generated_final_path")
114:         _require(type(identity["volume_serial"]) is int and 0 <= identity["volume_serial"] < 1 << 64,
115:                  "volume_serial_bound")
116:         file_id = identity["file_id"]
117:         _require(type(file_id) is str and len(file_id) == 32 and all(char in "0123456789abcdef" for char in file_id),
118:                  "file_id_shape")
119:         _require(type(identity["size"]) is int and identity["size"] == len(GENERATED[name])
120:                  and type(identity["links"]) is int and identity["links"] == 1
121:                  and identity["directory"] is False, "generated_file_shape")
122:         expected = FileIdentity(final_path, identity["volume_serial"], bytes.fromhex(file_id),
123:                                 identity["size"], 1, False)
124:         validated.append((name, value, expected, row["sha256"]))
125:     _require(type(expected_manifest_sha256) is str and len(expected_manifest_sha256) == 64
126:              and manifest_digest(payload) == expected_manifest_sha256, "authenticated_manifest_binding")
127:     return tuple(validated)

130: class InheritedReadSetAdoption:
131:     """One worker-local operation, owned by the fixed serial child flow.
132: 
133:     Refused owners are kept until that child exits. No arbitrary recovery or
134:     real namespace capability can be obtained by toggling a field here.
135:     """
136: 
137:     def __init__(self, primitives):
138:         self.primitives = primitives
139:         self.read_set = None
140:         self.assets = None
141:         self.namespace = None
142:         self.inheritance_cleared = 0
143:         self.identities_checked = 0
144:         self.observed_identities = []
145:         self.materialization_started = False
146:         self.status = "new"
147: 
148:     def adopt(self, authenticated_payload, root, case, control_value, manifest_sha256):
149:         _require(self.status == "new" and self.read_set is None, "single_adoption_attempt")
150:         self.status = "validating"
151:         try:
152:             rows = validate_manifest(authenticated_payload, root, case, control_value, manifest_sha256)
153:             _require(not any(not handle.closed and handle.value in {row[1] for row in rows}
154:                              for handle in self.primitives.handles), "inherited_handle_already_owned")
155:             read_set = ReadSet()
156:             self.read_set = read_set
157:             self.primitives.read_sets.append(read_set)
158:             # All partial owners precede inheritance and identity queries. The
159:             # control endpoint is already separately owned, and cannot overlap.
160:             for name, value, expected, digest in rows:
161:                 read_set.members.append(self.primitives._retain(value, "adopted-generated-member"))
162:             ffi = self.primitives.api.ffi
163:             for handle in read_set.members:
164:                 flags = ffi.c_uint32()
165:                 self.primitives.api.checked("GetHandleInformation", self.primitives._owned(handle), ffi.byref(flags))
166:                 _require(flags.value == 1, "exact_inherited_handle_flag_required")
167:                 self.primitives.api.checked("SetHandleInformation", self.primitives._owned(handle), 1, 0)
168:                 self.primitives.api.checked("GetHandleInformation", self.primitives._owned(handle), ffi.byref(flags))
169:                 _require(flags.value == 0, "inherited_flag_not_cleared")
170:                 self.inheritance_cleared += 1
171:             for handle, row in zip(read_set.members, rows):
172:                 actual = self.primitives.identity(handle)
173:                 self.identities_checked += 1
174:                 self.observed_identities.append(_identity_row(actual))
175:                 _require(actual == row[2], "inherited_file_identity_mismatch")
176:                 read_set.identities.append(actual)
177:             self.assets = tuple(BufferAsset(row[0], row[2].size, row[3], handle)
178:                                 for handle, row in zip(read_set.members, rows))
179:             self.status = "adopted"
180:             return self
181:         except BaseException:
182:             self.status = "refused"
183:             if self.read_set is not None:
184:                 self.read_set.unconfirmed = True
185:             raise
186: 
187:     def materialize_generated(self):
188:         _require(self.status == "adopted" and not self.materialization_started, "adoption_before_readback")
189:         self.materialization_started = True
190:         try:
191:             self.namespace = PinnedBufferNamespace(self.primitives, self.read_set, self.assets, PAYLOAD_BYTES).materialize()
192:             _require(self.namespace.namespace_sha256 == namespace_digest(), "complete_generated_namespace_digest")
193:             for name in NAMES:
194:                 _require(self.namespace.lookup(name) == GENERATED[name], "generated_complete_byte_readback")
195:             self.status = "materialized"
196:             return {"namespace_sha256": namespace_digest(), "payload_bytes": PAYLOAD_BYTES,
197:                     "members": [{"name": name, "bytes": len(GENERATED[name]),
198:                                  "sha256": hashlib.sha256(GENERATED[name]).hexdigest()} for name in NAMES]}
199:         except BaseException:
200:             self.status = "refused"
201:             self.read_set.unconfirmed = True
202:             raise
203: 
204:     def release_after_reads(self):
205:         _require(self.status == "materialized" and self.read_set is not None and not self.read_set.unconfirmed,
206:                  "only_successful_readback_can_release")
207:         # No worker belongs to this child-local set and all synchronous reads
208:         # have returned. The parent guards remain held through actual exit.
209:         result = self.primitives.release_read_set(self.read_set)
210:         _require(result is True and self.read_set.released, "child_read_guard_release_unconfirmed")
211:         self.status = "released"
212:         return True
213: 
214:     def receipt(self):
215:         return {"status": self.status, "owned_members": len(self.read_set.members) if self.read_set else 0,
216:                 "inheritance_cleared": self.inheritance_cleared, "identities_checked": self.identities_checked,
217:                 "observed_identities": list(self.observed_identities),
218:                 "materialization_started": self.materialization_started,
219:                 "read_set_unconfirmed": self.read_set.unconfirmed if self.read_set else None,
220:                 "read_set_released": self.read_set.released if self.read_set else False,
221:                 "handles_closed": [handle.closed for handle in self.read_set.members] if self.read_set else [],
222:                 "complete_native_namespace_protection": False, "model_calls": 0}

1: """Source-only exact-handle buffer namespace; no model or path I/O at import.
2: 
3: This implements Python-side closed membership. Native CTranslate2 files-reader
4: closure, memory use and real model authority remain unqualified and disabled.
5: """
6: from dataclasses import dataclass
7: import hashlib
8: import json
9: from types import MappingProxyType
10: 
11: FOUR = frozenset(("config.json", "model.bin", "tokenizer.json", "vocabulary.txt"))
12: FIVE = frozenset(("config.json", "model.bin", "preprocessor_config.json", "tokenizer.json", "vocabulary.json"))
13: CHUNK = 65536
14: MAX_MODEL_BYTES = 4 * 1024 * 1024 * 1024
15: REAL_NATIVE_FILES_READER_BINDING = None
16: 
17: 
18: class NamespaceRefusal(RuntimeError):
19:     pass
20: 
21: 
22: def _require(condition, reason):
23:     if not condition:
24:         raise NamespaceRefusal(reason)
25: 
26: 
27: def declare_read_calls(api, kernel32):
28:     # Future trusted bootstrap provides the same already-bound system DLL/FFI.
29:     # This function does not load a DLL or import ctypes, and is not run here.
30:     ffi = api.ffi
31:     read = kernel32.ReadFile
32:     read.restype = ffi.c_int32
33:     read.argtypes = [ffi.c_void_p, ffi.c_void_p, ffi.c_uint32, ffi.POINTER(ffi.c_uint32), ffi.c_void_p]
34:     seek = kernel32.SetFilePointerEx
35:     seek.restype = ffi.c_int32
36:     seek.argtypes = [ffi.c_void_p, ffi.c_int64, ffi.POINTER(ffi.c_int64), ffi.c_uint32]
37:     api.functions["ReadFile"], api.functions["SetFilePointerEx"] = read, seek
38: 
39: 
40: @dataclass(frozen=True)
41: class BufferAsset:
42:     name: str
43:     size: int
44:     sha256: str
45:     handle: object
46: 
47: 
48: class PinnedBufferNamespace:
49:     """One materialization of exact approved names from owned retained handles.
50: 
51:     Asset values must be derived from the existing admitted manifest by trusted
52:     bootstrap code. Constructing BufferAsset records does not authenticate them.
53:     A real loader is never invoked by this class.
54:     """
55: 
56:     def __init__(self, primitives, read_set, assets, payload_budget):
57:         _require(any(item is read_set for item in primitives.read_sets) and not read_set.unconfirmed
58:                  and not read_set.released and not read_set.worker_reserved, "fresh_owned_read_set_required")
59:         _require(type(assets) is tuple and len(assets) in (4, 5), "complete_asset_schema")
60:         names = [asset.name for asset in assets if type(asset) is BufferAsset]
61:         _require(len(names) == len(assets) and len(set(names)) == len(names) and frozenset(names) in (FOUR, FIVE),
62:                  "exact_asset_names_required")
63:         _require(type(payload_budget) is int and 0 < payload_budget <= MAX_MODEL_BYTES, "explicit_payload_budget")
64:         subtotal = 0
65:         seen_handles = []
66:         for asset in assets:
67:             _require(type(asset.size) is int and 0 < asset.size <= MAX_MODEL_BYTES, "asset_size")
68:             _require(type(asset.sha256) is str and len(asset.sha256) == 64
69:                      and all(char in "0123456789abcdef" for char in asset.sha256), "asset_sha256")
70:             _require(any(handle is asset.handle for handle in read_set.members)
71:                      and not any(handle is asset.handle for handle in seen_handles), "asset_handle_ownership")
72:             seen_handles.append(asset.handle)
73:             subtotal += asset.size
74:         _require(subtotal <= payload_budget, "model_payload_budget")
75:         self._primitives, self._read_set, self._assets = primitives, read_set, assets
76:         # Payload size only: chunks plus join can temporarily duplicate a file.
77:         # Python object overhead and any later native copies are additional.
78:         # This is not a process working-set/RAM cap or real loader admission.
79:         self._payload_budget = payload_budget
80:         self._started = False
81:         self._ready = False
82:         self._buffers = None
83:         self.namespace_sha256 = None
84: 
85:     def materialize(self):
86:         _require(not self._started and not self._read_set.unconfirmed and not self._read_set.released,
87:                  "namespace_single_materialization")
88:         self._started = True
89:         primitives, ffi = self._primitives, self._primitives.api.ffi
90:         buffers = {}
91:         try:
92:             for asset in self._assets:
93:                 before = primitives.identity(asset.handle)
94:                 _require(not before.directory and before.links == 1 and before.size == asset.size, "owned_file_identity")
95:                 position = ffi.c_int64()
96:                 primitives.api.checked("SetFilePointerEx", primitives._owned(asset.handle), 0, ffi.byref(position), 0)
97:                 _require(position.value == 0, "owned_file_position")
98:                 chunks, total = [], 0
99:                 digest = hashlib.sha256()
100:                 while True:
101:                     # Read at most the remaining approved length plus one byte.
102:                     # Allocate one fixed-size scratch buffer, not a growing read.
103:                     requested = min(CHUNK, asset.size - total + 1)
104:                     scratch = ffi.create_string_buffer(requested)
105:                     count = ffi.c_uint32()
106:                     primitives.api.checked("ReadFile", primitives._owned(asset.handle), scratch,
107:                                            requested, ffi.byref(count), None)
108:                     _require(0 <= count.value <= requested, "read_count_bound")
109:                     if count.value == 0:
110:                         break
111:                     total += count.value
112:                     _require(total <= asset.size, "asset_grew_during_read")
113:                     chunk = bytes(scratch.raw[:count.value])
114:                     digest.update(chunk)
115:                     chunks.append(chunk)
116:                 _require(total == asset.size and digest.hexdigest() == asset.sha256, "owned_asset_digest")
117:                 _require(primitives.identity(asset.handle) == before, "owned_asset_identity_changed")
118:                 buffers[asset.name] = b"".join(chunks)
119:             # Immutable bytes plus a nonmutable membership view. The eventual
120:             # B3 caller needs a fresh dictionary because it pops two entries.
121:             self._buffers = MappingProxyType(buffers)
122:             binding = [[asset.name, asset.size, asset.sha256] for asset in sorted(self._assets, key=lambda item: item.name)]
123:             self.namespace_sha256 = hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(binding, separators=(",", ":")).encode("ascii")).hexdigest()
124:             self._ready = True
125:             return self
126:         except BaseException:
127:             self._read_set.unconfirmed = True
128:             self._buffers = None
129:             self._ready = False
130:             raise
131: 
132:     def lookup(self, name):
133:         _require(self._ready and not self._read_set.unconfirmed and not self._read_set.released, "namespace_not_live")
134:         _require(type(name) is str and name in self._buffers, "unknown_model_filename")
135:         return self._buffers[name]
136: 
137:     def proposed_loader_arguments(self):
138:         _require(self._ready and not self._read_set.unconfirmed and not self._read_set.released, "namespace_not_live")
139:         # This creates reviewable data only; it does not invoke any constructor.
140:         # Four-file models require a separately reviewed no-preprocessor path;
141:         # no fabricated preprocessor is silently added to their approved set.
142:         _require("preprocessor_config.json" in self._buffers, "four_file_preprocessor_path_requires_review")
143:         return {"model_size_or_path": "uoink-memory-" + self.namespace_sha256,
144:                 "local_files_only": True, "files": dict(self._buffers)}
145: 
146:     def activate_real_loader(self, *args, **kwargs):
147:         # A caller cannot set the module variable to bypass missing authority.
148:         raise NamespaceRefusal("native_files_reader_and_model_stack_are_not_admitted")
149: 
150: 
151: def acquire_real_read_namespace(*args, **kwargs):
152:     # Current source proves neither Windows child-name exclusion nor native
153:     # CTranslate2 files-map closure. Refuse before any artifact operation.
154:     raise NamespaceRefusal("complete_native_loader_namespace_unproved")
